rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: never verse by verse — reading one: K-C bars resolving this D4/C2 collision by isolating Luke 2:48-49 and its immediate qualification; reading two: that is permissible contextual reading. I used reading one.
why: Because the judge's stated reason is a verse-level qualification of Luke 2:48-49, it fails K-C's requirement to weigh the collision chain against chain by footing when the pressed witnesses are the pressing side's own chain.
